query:
SELECT
                ht.id AS token_id,
                h.id AS harness_id,
                h.owner_user_id,
                h.created_by
            FROM harness_tokens ht
            JOIN harnesses h ON h.id = ht.harness_id
            WHERE ht.token_hash = $1
              AND ht.revoked_at IS NULL
              AND h.deleted_at IS NULL
